body:
## Summary

When `@sepo-agent` starts a run it reacts 👀 on the trigger, then can go silent until it posts a final reply — often many minutes later. The only intermediate visibility is the GitHub Actions log, which requires leaving the issue/PR.

This PR adds a live progress comment: right after the run begins, Sepo posts one comment on the triggering issue or PR and edits it in place on a throttle as the agent works, rendering a human-friendly view of what it's doing: tools used, files touched, milestone messages, elapsed time, and step count. When the run ends, that progress comment can collapse into a tidy activity log; final answers/status comments merge into it where supported, with fallback to normal posting when merge data is unavailable.

It also adds a control signal: the reporter polls reactions on the progress comment, and an authorized 👎 cancels/aborts the in-flight run cleanly — no pause/resume.

The capture source is the ACP NDJSON stream `acpx` already emits, so no agent prompt changes are required. A standalone reporter process tails that stream, keeping the design decoupled and unit-testable.

This sync also includes follow-up hardening from the internal development branch: progress policy configuration, orchestration defaults/opt-in, workflow/docs updates, and shared actor association/env helpers.

## Verification

Local verification performed against the imported tree before opening this PR:

- `npm ci`
- `npm test`

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: 0010cd5f1e95e6a700391eb2d6c30f12fff5503d -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #429 adds live Sepo progress comments for long-running agent work, including in-place updates, a collapsed activity log, and final-response merging. It also adds authorized thumbs-down cancellation for cancellable direct runs, backed by ACP stream capture and a separate reporter process. The PR updates route policy, workflow wiring, tests, and docs for the new progress behavior. The PR is currently `MERGED` at `0010cd5f1e95e6a700391eb2d6c30f12fff5503d`.

## Review
Overall, reviewers found the design sound, well-tested, and non-blocking. The only material concern is an edge case where outer GitHub step timeouts can bypass the reporter cleanup path.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Progress comments can be orphaned on outer task timeout | WARNING | `progress_comment_id` is emitted only by the composite action cleanup step, but callers timeout the entire composite action. If that timeout fires, the final status can fall back to a separate comment while the live progress comment remains stale. |
| Unauthorized cancel reactions are re-checked every poll | INFO | A lingering unauthorized thumbs-down can trigger repeated association lookups every poll because negative authorization results are not cached. This is an API/rate-cost issue, not an authorization bypass. |
| Optional cleanup notes | INFO | Reviewer cleanup notes covered a misleading parser name, a dead `filter(...)`, first-marker-only extraction, and documenting that cancel-enabled routes need `actions: write`. None are blocking. |

## Progress
- Existing inline comments and review threads were empty before synthesis.
- Posted one new inline warning on `.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml:458` for the timeout/finalization edge case.
- No comments were minimized, no threads were resolved, and no replies were added.
- Rubrics review passed; both code-review lanes reported no blocking bugs.
- Reviewers reported successful verification with `npm test`; rubrics review also reported focused build/test coverage.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Progress comments can be orphaned on outer task timeout</summary>

**Cause:** At PR head, [`run-agent-task`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/0010cd5f1e95e6a700391eb2d6c30f12fff5503d/.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml#L458) exposes `progress_comment_id` from the `Stop progress reporter` step, while callers like [`agent-implement.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/0010cd5f1e95e6a700391eb2d6c30f12fff5503d/.github/workflows/agent-implement.yml#L226) and [`agent-fix-pr.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/0010cd5f1e95e6a700391eb2d6c30f12fff5503d/.github/workflows/agent-fix-pr.yml#L183) apply `timeout-minutes` to the whole composite action.

**Candidate solutions:** Move timeout enforcement inside `run-agent-task` around `node .agent/dist/run.js`, or let callers rediscover and finalize the progress comment by marker/run id if the composite action times out.

**Comments:** This was raised by the Codex reviewer and verified against the PR head. It is non-blocking but worth follow-up if stale progress comments on timeouts are unacceptable.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Unauthorized cancel reactions are re-checked every poll</summary>

**Cause:** [`findCancelReactionBestEffort`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/0010cd5f1e95e6a700391eb2d6c30f12fff5503d/.agent/src/cli/progress-report.ts#L452) lists reactions and delegates to authorization checks each poll; unauthorized negative results are not memoized.

**Candidate solutions:** Cache normalized logins that have already resolved as unauthorized for the life of the reporter process, while preserving requester and trusted-actor short-circuit behavior.

**Comments:** Claude flagged this as low warning. It is an efficiency concern only; the trust boundary still fails closed.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Optional cleanup notes</summary>

**Cause:** Claude noted several small maintainability issues: `parseDurationMs` is reused for byte counts, `mergeFinalBodyWithProgress` has a no-op filter, marker extraction strips only the first marker, and docs could state that cancel-enabled routes require `actions: write`.

**Candidate solutions:** Rename or split the bounded-int parser, simplify the join path in `progress-final-comment.ts`, leave marker behavior as-is unless comment reuse is added, and add the permission note near `AGENT_PROGRESS_POLICY` docs.

**Comments:** These are opportunistic cleanups and should not drive automation on this merged PR.
</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`HUMAN_DECISION`: PR #429 is already merged, and the remaining warning has multiple reasonable follow-up designs, so maintainers should decide whether to open a follow-up hardening PR.

## Final Verdict
`MINOR_ISSUES`

- [ ] No required branch-change work remains for PR #429.
